title: Autoremediation router for silent canary degradations and customer triage
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a lightweight 'autoremediation router' that automatically triages low-signal ("silent") canary degradations, triggers targeted mitigation actions (thin rollbacks, micro-traffic-splits, synthetic rehydration), and surfaces a clear customer-facing triage lane for SRE/field-ops. The router should reduce mean-time-to-mitigation for regressions that do not immediately trip existing circuit-breakers but cause slow quality/latency erosion for subsets of tenants.
background: We frequently observe regressions that manifest as subtle increase in hallucination or P95 latency for only a slice of tenants (region/plan/tenant-slice). Existing playbooks require manual triage and full model reversion. That process is slow and noisy for customers. This ticket consolidates detection signals, a decision matrix, and automated remediation actions to shrink blast radius and reduce manual toil.
acceptance_criteria: Router consumes standard canary signals (quality regression score, latency P95, throughput drop) and classifies event severity with >=85% precision on historical incidents
Router can execute three mitigation actions via control plane APIs: micro-rollback (route 10%->baseline), tenant-fenced throttle, synthetic-request rehydration
SRE console shows causal factors and recommended action; executing recommended action is one-click from UI
End-to-end tests cover classification decisions and action execution in staging with synthetic tenants
Playbook including customer notification templates is documented and linked from the console
technical_design_summary: A small decision service subscribes to CanaryTelemetry (Kafka) and evaluates a sliding-window feature vector (per-tenant stat aggregates). A lightweight classifier (rules + light ML ensemble) outputs a remediation candidate and confidence. If confidence > threshold, orchestrate action via the rollout API: create micro-slice, shift 10% traffic to fallback variant, trigger KV cache warm for fallback, and spin synthetic rehydration jobs. All actions are transactional and emit audit events. Fail-open: if orchestration fails, alert SRE but do not change runtime traffic.
playbook_steps: 1) On alert, router writes candidate to console and notifies oncall with summary
2) If confidence low, assign to field-ops with suggested tests; if high, execute automated micro-rollback
3) After action, run automated evals on canary query-set (5m/15m/1h) and decide to escalate to full rollback or revert the micro action
4) If customer impact high, send templated customer comms via CX channel and schedule field call
rollback_flow: Primary mitigation is micro-rollforward/back: create a tenant-scoped traffic split to a known-good variant. If post-action evals show persistent degradation, escalate to full rollback with a one-click orchestration that reconciles KV caches and invalidates warmed prefixes across nodes. All rollback actions include automatic reconciliation tasks for KV cache and embedding caches.
communication_plan: Console shows a summarized ticket with recommended cadence. Templates are in Drive (link in incident_links). Field-ops uses the 'tenant triage' template for initial comms; escalations trigger a targeted mailing list and account manager involvement. For high-impact customers, include an opt-out and dedicated remediation SLA timeline.
test_plan: Unit tests for classifier thresholds and decision logic
Integration tests in staging that simulate staggered signal increases across tenant slices
Chaos test: failure of orchestration API should not mutate traffic (fail-open)
Synthetic-only regression suite that asserts KV rehydration occurs after micro-rollbacks
rollout_plan: Phase 1: run in passive mode (observations only) for 2 weeks and compare detections to historical incidents. Phase 2: enable autobuffered execution in non-production planes for select tenanted workloads. Phase 3: enable for low-risk production customers behind a feature flag. Gate full enablement on 0 false positives in 30 days and SRE signoff.
